name: SDF-based Voxelization
aliases: Voxelization of CSG Meshes and Analytic Primitives
definition: A method to visualize any Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) mesh or analytic primitive as a Minecraft-style voxel chunk pile by determining world-space bounding boxes, sampling a 3D grid, and querying Signed Distance Fields (SDF) to determine occupancy.
summary: SDF-based Voxelization converts CSG meshes into voxel chunks via CPU SDF queries, differing from GPU rasterization by storing results in packed bitmaps for path tracing without shader changes.
